Configuration: 5.0L TFSI V10 Quattro (Tiptronic) RS6 Plus Geneva Auto Show Debut Car (EU) [Avant] 2010
Description: 2010 Avant 5.0L TFSI V10 (580 HP) with 6-Speed Tiptronic Transmission, Quattro permanent 40/60 four-wheel-drive and RS6 plus sport suspension. This model is equipped with RS6 plus package with elements from audi exclusive brochure, black styling package, matt-black roof bars, carbon design package, xenon headlights, LED taillights, adaptive lights, audi advanced parking system, insulated and acoustic glass with privacy tint, side-assist package, lane-assist package, high-beam assistant, start-stop system, key-less system, homelink system, power folding auto-dimming mirrors with memory, electric slide and tilt solar sunroof, 20-inch alloys, high infotainment system with HDD based satellite navigation, AMI audi music interface and a 6-disc CD changer, DAB digital radio module, high mobile phone preparation with bluetooth, auto-dimming rear view mirror, electrically adjustable seats, automatically actuated tailgate, load-area fixing kit, load-area lockable side compartment, partition net, storage package, smoker package, premium lighting package, rear and side manual window blind, climate control, BOSE surround sound audio system, black interior, carbon atlas inlay finish, alabaster white valcona leather seats. Exterior painted in Ipanema Brown. At the Geneva Motor Show in March 2010, quattro GmbH unveiled the RS6 Plus, a final tribute to the legendary C6 generation. Limited to exactly 500 numbered units. This limited edition marked the grand finale for the C6 generation, and in July 2010, production of the Audi RS6 and its iconic twin-turbo V10 engine officially came to an end. This configuration is an exact replica of the car that was showcased at the Geneva Motor Show in March 2010.
